## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Unit/static tests pass.
- [ ] Relevant smoke or integration test was run, or the limitation is stated.
- [ ] Reference build and resource versions are documented.
- [ ] Results and limitations are described without clinical overclaiming.

## Data protection

- [ ] No patient data, identifiers, confidential paths or patient-derived
      reports are included.
- [ ] Test data are public with documented use conditions, or synthetic.

## Checklist

- [ ] Documentation is updated.
- [ ] The staged diff contains only intended files.
- [ ] Backwards-compatibility or migration impact is described.
